title: Unreconciled

inlines.v: UNRECONCI'LED, adjective 1. Not reconciled; not made consistent. 2. Not appeased; not having become favorable. 3. In a theological sense, not having laid aside opposition and enmity to God; not having made peace with God through faith in Christ.
